ablationsOnDevelopmentAreas.ablationName: Crop Resolution: 640x640 vs 1024x1024 (Top 6 Views per Dev Area)
ablationsOnDevelopmentAreas.notes: Evaluated on the top 6 facade views per development area (12 views total). Higher crop resolution (1024px) sharpens recessed doorway frames beyond 20m but also increases small window/panel detections.

ablationsOnDevelopmentAreas.ablationName: Localisation Geometry: Single-Ray vs Multi-View Triangulation
ablationsOnDevelopmentAreas.notes: Clustering sightings across adjacent stations prior to deduplication merges duplicate single-station rays and improves localisation accuracy on shared facades.

ablationsOnDevelopmentAreas.ablationName: Crop Verification: Without Gemini Verifier vs With Gemini Verifier
ablationsOnDevelopmentAreas.notes: Gemini Flash crop verification rejects window bays, posters, and vehicle reflections that SAM 3.1 scores >= 0.55, substantially improving precision.

baselineComparison.groundTruthDifferenceNote: The Deep Research human/street-view baseline (83% precision, 62% recall, 4.3m mean error) evaluated against exhaustively field-verified physical doors along short street blocks. Our Step 5 evaluation scores pure perception against crowdsourced OpenStreetMap entrance=* nodes visible within 40m and inside planned 90-degree views. Because OSM entrance=* tagging is incomplete on commercial/retail facades alongside major transit stations, many real physical doors detected by SAM 3.1 + Gemini Flash (verified on a second wider crop as likely_real_door_missing_from_osm) have no corresponding OSM node and are scored strictly as false positives.
